when.expression: #[vars.customerId == null or isBlank(vars.customerId) or not ((vars.customerId as String) matches /^[0-9]+$/)]

raise-error.description: customerId is required and must be a positive numeric value
raise-error.doc:name: Invalid Customer ID

db:select.doc:name: Fetch Customer
db:select.db:sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, date_of_birth, pan, aadhaar, address_line, city, state, postal_code FROM banking.customers WHERE customer_id = :customerId;

logger.message: Customer #[vars.customerId] found. Fetching accounts and KYC.
logger.doc:name: Log Customer Found

db:select.doc:name: Fetch Accounts
db:select.db:sql: SELECT account_number, customer_id, account_type, balance, account_status, created_at FROM banking.accounts WHERE customer_id = :customerId;

db:select.doc:name: Fetch KYC
db:select.db:sql: SELECT verification_id, customer_id, pan_verified, aadhaar_verified, verification_status, remarks, verified_at, created_at FROM banking.kyc_verifications WHERE customer_id = :customerId;

logger.message: #[write({ correlationId: correlationId, flow: 'customer-dashboard-flow', httpStatus: (vars.httpStatus default 200), durationMs: (now() as Number {unit: 'milliseconds'}) - (vars.startTime as Number {unit: 'milliseconds'}), outcome: 'SUCCESS' }, 'application/json')]
logger.doc:name: Success Log
